title: BAD FIT
text: BAD FIT. This cover doesn't fix well on a queen size air mattress....the corners keep slipping off when lying on the air mattress...it says it fits a queen size but this is not true...it does go on (barely) but the corners don't always stay on while you are sleeping......it's very frustrating.

product_metadata.title: Intex Queen Quilted Airbed Air Mattress up to 22" Tall (Cover Only, Grey)
features: Fitted polyester bed cover (air mattress sold separately)
Add a layer of comfort to your air mattress
Fits mid rise to double high queen airbeds, up to 22 inches tall
description: Make your air mattress extra cozy for you or your guest when you throw on the Intex Queen Airbed Cover. This quilted polyester cover adds a comfortable layer to your airbed, making it feel a little bit more like home. This cover fits mid rise to double high queen sized air mattresses, up to 22 inches tall. It has a thread count of 200 and is 100% polyester. The elegant quilted pattern looks like your mattress' cover. This cover fits your airbed snugly when strapped on and doesn't slide off in the middle of the night.
